title: DDR Museum

groundCutout.basis: The narrow public approach in front of the below-street museum must remain open beside the terrace.

buildingCutout.basis: Named native upper host building perimeter, with the museum at its riverfront level.

terrainReference.basis: Berlin 1 m DGM sample immediately outside the museum entrance on Vera-Brittain-Ufer.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap DDR Museum, mapped entrance, lower promenade and DomAquarée host wing relation.
mapIdentity.scope: The named museum basement footprint and entrance, public walkway, 16-step flight and host wing multipolygon locate the podium and stone and glazed building above. The complex’s other blocks are outside the scope.

note: The museum places its entrance on Vera-Brittain-Ufer about 20 metres from the bridge access; the facade consultant documents a roughly 30 m stone-clad, glazed building, with an inclined glass and foil roof for the upper atrium.
